en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 470 - Fadhl has narrated from Muhammad bin Ali from Ja’far bin Bashir from Khalid bin Amara from Mufaddal bin Umar that he said:

“Once we were discussing the subject of Imam Qaim and those who died waiting for him from among us. Imam Sadiq (a.s) said: When the Qaim rises up, someone will come and announce in the grave of every believer: Your Imam has risen, if you want to join, you may do so. Otherwise you may continue to lie in the mercy of God.”
